name: Toaru Kanojo no Netorare Kiroku ~Toshiue Osananajimi ga Hentai Kyoushi no Bitch Tsuma ni Naru Made~
original_name: とある彼女の寝取られ記録～年上幼馴染が変態教師のビッチ妻になるまで～
source:
Kazuki and Miyuki grew up together and became lovers. He was now zealously involved in the school's soccer club. But tragically, Miyuki's idol qualities and her connection to Kazuki's club made her a target for lascivious couselor, Shingo. One day he promised her to favor Kazuki on the team if she "favored" him...

For Kazuki's sake, Miyuki foolishly gave her body to Shingo, beginning a hell of constant trystes and creampie babymaking... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077982.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
向坂一树与高岛みゆき青梅竹马，后来结为恋人。如今，一树正全心投入学校足球社的活动。然而不幸的是，みゆき偶像般的气质以及她与足球社的关系，引来了好色顾问松本真悟的觊觎。某天，真悟承诺，只要她肯“照顾”自己，就会在球队里优待一树……

为了恋人，みゆき愚蠢地把身体交给真悟，从此坠入无休止的幽会与中出受孕地狱……
